title: Offered Biology instead of Medicine. Accept or rewrite JAMB??
where: CampusGist NG forum > Admissions & Post-UTME board

messages.author: Tolu_Aspirant
messages.body: Good evening house. Please I need advice urgently. I wrote JAMB this year and scored 268, did post-UTME and I was sure of Medicine. Today I checked the portal and they gave me Biology. I don't know what to do. My dad is saying I should accept it and transfer after first year, my aunty is saying I should reject it and rewrite because once you enter Biology you will finish in Biology. Acceptance fee deadline is next two weeks. I have been crying since afternoon honestly. Please anybody that has been in this situation should talk to me.

messages.author: Kingsley_MLS
messages.body: Rewrite. No two ways about it. Transfer to Medicine is a myth they use to console people. Out of my whole set, nobody I know moved from Biology to MBBS. One year is nothing, you are still young. Go and read for JAMB well and do the post UTME again, with 268 you are almost there.

messages.author: favour.o
messages.body: Accept it jor. A bird in hand is worth two in the bush. Do you know how many people would kill for that admission? You can transfer, my neighbour's son did it, just read hard in 100L. Don't stay at home one more year o, staying at home is not easy, you will see your mates going to school and you'll be depressed.

messages.author: Tolu_Aspirant
messages.body: Thank you both but this is exactly what is confusing me, one person says rewrite one person says accept. Is there anybody here that is actually in Biology 100L now, that wanted Medicine? I want to hear from someone who is inside it, how is it really, can you actually transfer, what do they require? And is Biology even bad as a course or is it just that I had my mind on Medicine? Please be honest with me.
